source: EXCERPT (values verbatim, not complete) from https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/models/capabilities/configure-safety-filters (2026-10-06; corrected 2026-10-07 after measurement D1): keeps 2 of the example's 4 safetyRatings and leaves out its usageMetadata { promptTokenCount: 38, totalTokenCount: 38 }, which test/google.test.ts adds back where usage is asserted. Candidate stopped by the safety filter: finishReason SAFETY, the offending rating has blocked: true, no content. Related finish reasons that also mean 'output withheld by a filter' (Agent Platform FinishReason): PROHIBITED_CONTENT, BLOCKLIST, SPII, IMAGE_SAFETY, IMAGE_PROHIBITED_CONTENT, MODEL_ARMOR; RECITATION/LANGUAGE stop output for non-safety reasons.
